method: Fresh WebGPU demo sessions share one device and alternate sleeping on/off at each fixed step, with alternating creation order on repeats. Steps stay queued between samples. GPU timestamps surround the complete physics step, including sleeping, water/force hooks and queue gaps. Drawing is excluded. Samples every ten steps; first 0.2 seconds excluded. Active = 0.2–2 seconds; later = last two seconds. Identical object counts, timesteps, iterations and actions; playgrounds start and the slingshot fires. Overflow, coloring conflicts and finite poses checked. Defaults require at least 10% mean time saved in every repeat, without more than 15% active-time regression. Measurements depend on hardware and scene motion.
